content: Research-code release discipline (community consensus, e.g. Software Sustainability Institute / Turing Way, not primary-verified): archive and tag the as-published state before touching anything; first public pass = hygiene only (README, LICENSE, CITATION, pinned env, relative paths) with no algorithmic/structural changes; capture golden outputs/checksums BEFORE refactoring; add characterization tests; refactor incrementally under CI with an explicit equivalence policy (bitwise vs rtol/atol tolerance) documented in CHANGELOG. Results break on 'safe' refactors via float reordering, library version drift (numpy 1.x-2.x, BLAS backends), notebook hidden state, RNG API changes, and load-bearing dead code (hard-coded constants that look removable). Feathers' characterization tests; PRIMAD+ implementation-axis taxonomy (Kapoor & Narayanan 2023).
